about: Real-world set (2026-10-08): 30 requests phrased the way people ask, across topics, including Nimit's own first try ('how gradient descent works?'). Graded by eye on three axes: correct, visuals, explanation. Used to measure every v1.1+ change; never trained on. Some overlap held-out topics on purpose -- the app uses the release library.
